study type: Before and after retrospective cohort study
exposure: Implementation of a patient-safety bundle for placenta accreta spectrum
outcome: Incorporation of all six components of the patient-safety bundle
Antenatal suspicion of placenta accreta spectrum
cohort: 39 patients with suspected placenta accreta spectrum
finding: Implementation of a patient-safety bundle for placenta accreta spectrum improved adherence to standardized management and did not significantly affect maternal or postoperative outcomes.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery was 36.8 +/- 2.52 weeks in the post-protocol group and 33.87 +/- 2.4 weeks in the pre-protocol group.
